purpose: Reads the current top stories on Hacker News and writes a short digest of the ones about a topic the caller names.

features.name: Topic Digest
features.does: Reads top stories from Hacker News and generates a short digest matching a caller-named topic.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.about: The subject to filter the Hacker News stories by.

outputs.name: digest
outputs.about: A short digest of the matching stories. Each story includes its title, link, points, and one plain sentence on why it matters.

requirements.shall: The agent shall read the current top stories on Hacker News.

source.said: Reads the current top stories on Hacker News

requirements.shall: The agent shall write a short digest of the stories about a topic the caller names.

source.said: writes a short digest of the ones about a topic the caller names

requirements.shall: The agent shall include each story's title, link, points and one plain sentence on why it matters.

source.said: each story's title, link, points and one plain sentence on why it matters.

requirements.shall: The agent shall refuse writing about stories it did not read from Hacker News.

source.said: Writing about stories it did not read from Hacker News

requirements.shall: The agent shall refuse inventing points, links or comments.
The agent shall refuse posting, voting or commenting on Hacker News.

source.said: posting, voting or commenting on Hacker News

acceptance.gherkin:
Scenario: Creating a topic digest
  Given a topic named "databases"
  When the agent reads the current top stories on Hacker News
  Then it writes a short digest of the ones about the topic
  And each story has its title, link, points and one plain sentence on why it matters

Scenario: Refusing disallowed actions
  Given a request to comment on a story
  When the agent processes the request
  Then it refuses to post, vote or comment on Hacker News

constraints.shall: The agent shall hold the model used to write the sentences to a spending ceiling of 1 USD per day.

source.said: spending ceiling of 1 USD per day

systems.name: Hacker News API
systems.why: To retrieve the current top stories (the official Firebase API: /topstories.json and /item/<id>.json, read only, no key).

settings.name: top_stories_to_read
settings.about: How many top stories to read from Hacker News.

settings.name: stories_in_digest
settings.about: How many stories to put in the digest.
